question: In a right circular cylinder, diameter of the base is 21 cm. If eight times the sum of the areas of its two circular faces is five times the area of its curved surface, find the volume of the cylinder (in cm³ ). (Take pi = (22)/(7) )
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Diameter = 21 ⇒ r = 10.5 cm

Condition ⇒ 8(2πr²) = 5(2πrh)

⇒ 16πr² = 10πrh ⇒ h = 1.6r = 16.8 cm

Volume = πr²h = (22/7)×(10.5)²×16.8

**∴ Answer = 5821.2 cm³**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Diameter = 21 cm ⇒ radius r = 10.5 cm

8 × (sum of areas of two circular faces) = 5 × curved surface area

**Formula used:**

Area of two bases = 2πr², Curved surface area = 2πrh

**Calculation:**

⇒ 8 × (2πr²) = 5 × (2πrh)

⇒ 16πr² = 10πrh

⇒ 16r = 10h

⇒ h = 16r/10 = 1.6r

⇒ h = 1.6 × 10.5 = 16.8 cm

⇒ Volume = πr²h

⇒ = (22/7) × (10.5)² × 16.8

⇒ = (22/7) × 110.25 × 16.8

⇒ = 5821.2 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 5821.2 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cylinder Formulas

Volume = πr²h, Curved surface area = 2πrh

Base Area

Area of two circular faces = 2πr²

Key Trick

Cancel π and simplify before substituting values.
